text: Database connection pool exhausted due to increased traffic. Increasing pool size resolved the issue.
Application timeout caused by slow SQL queries. Query optimization resolved the incident.
Recent deployment introduced configuration issue causing service degradation.
LDAP connection timeout caused authentication requests to fail. Reviewing LDAP server connectivity and increasing connection timeout resolved the issue.
Users were unable to reset passwords because the LDAP authentication service was experiencing high latency. LDAP server health checks and connection pool tuning resolved the incident.
Authentication failures occurred because of intermittent LDAP connectivity problems. Network connectivity and LDAP server availability were restored to resolve the issue.
API requests returned HTTP 401 errors because authentication tokens were rejected. Reviewing token validation and identity provider configuration resolved the issue.
API Gateway returned intermittent HTTP 503 errors due to unhealthy backend service instances. Restarting unhealthy instances resolved the incident.
Email notifications were delayed because the notification queue contained a large backlog. Increasing worker capacity and clearing the queue resolved the issue.
File uploads failed because the document storage service was unavailable. Restoring storage connectivity resolved the incident.
